newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks slide further on Brazil shock.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks slide further on Brazil shock.

text.p: Mexican shares sharply extended their earlier slide in late trade Tuesday in an echo of plunging equities in Brazil, dealers said.
"The market is using Brazil as a pretext for taking profits," a floor trader said.
"The market is sliding in relatively moderate volume, albeit in brisker trade than when we slid on Friday and Monday," a promoter added.
The leading IPC share index was down 115.98 points, or 2.43 percent, at 4,661.09.

The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index in Brazil was meanwhile down 1,083 points to 11,615 as funds bailed out amid fears of devaluation triggered by volatile currencies in Asian emerging markets, traders said.
